property_summary: For any address proposer, when proposer is the current owner, calling transferOwnership(proposedNew) succeeds and sets C.owner() == proposedNew; the mutant inverts the guard so a call by the current owner will be rejected and thus owner will differ for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Change the onlyOwner modifier to check owner != msg.sender instead of equality, inverting the guard so only non-owners can execute transferOwnership.
